purpose: Frozen known-baseline of prerequisite IDs that the current approved objective data references but does NOT yet define as objectives. Per the Objective Registry & Standards proposal (SS7.5, owner correction A), these pre-existing referenced-but-undefined IDs are RECORDED, not gated: they do not block the global graph gate. Only a NEW referenced-undefined ID introduced after this baseline was frozen is a blocking error (newReferencedUndefined). Authoring these foundational objectives is out of scope for Phase 1 and reserved for a separate, owner-gated phase (SS16.5); the baseline shrinks by exactly one ID only when the corresponding objective is later authored and its reference resolves.
